subject: [PATCH v5 09/22] ntfs: convert iomap ops to ->iomap_next()

2026-07-29.patch_summary: This patch converts the iomap operations for NTFS to use the new ->iomap_next() callback, which is generated using macros that wrap the iomap_iter_next() helper. This change does not introduce any functional changes and is a conversion to the new API. The patch updates several functions in fs/ntfs/iomap.c to use the new callback, including ntfs_read_iomap_begin, ntfs_zero_read_iomap_end, ntfs_write_iomap_end, and others. The Acked-by and Signed-off-by fields indicate that the patch has been reviewed and approved by other kernel developers.
